title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage - Episode 1
summary: The introductory episode of Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari's discussion on the contrast between Umayyad heritage and broader Islamic heritage regarding the persona and status of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
series_en: Debates in Beliefs - The Greatest Messenger in Islamic Heritage
